resources.string: Pick your own, legally-owned APK file. This app does not contain or download any game files - it only modifies your own file and writes a patched copy.
Use my own keystore (default: auto-generated, stored key)

Off by default. Bakes in android:screenOrientation=user, same effect as the \"am compat enable OVERRIDE_ANY_ORIENTATION_TO_USER\" adb command - but built into the APK. Only rotates if your device\'s own auto-rotate is on, and a game that sets its own orientation at startup can still override it. Works for any game.

Off by default. Bakes in android:resizeableActivity=true, same effect as the \"am compat enable FORCE_RESIZE_APP\" adb command. Note: on some devices/launchers this alone can make the game open in a smaller floating window instead of fullscreen by default - try leaving this off (and using only free rotation above) if that happens.
To use your own keystore, pick a file and enter both the alias and the password.

A full uninstall sometimes leaves a leftover Android/obb folder behind, which can then block the next install (black screen / "IO Error" / game won\'t start). This deletes that package\'s whole obb folder - copy your own .obb file and videos back in afterward, before launching the game.

%1$s

You'll need to copy the .obb file and videos back in by hand before launching the game.

This game must keep its data files in the OBB folder, NOT in the DATA folder.

After installing: start the game once and close it, then (game closed) copy the game's data files into

Android/obb/com.ea.games.meinfiltrator_gamepad/

and NOT into Android/data/.

If an older Mass Effect is already installed, uninstall it first.

SoA (Save old APK)
Version %1$s

Tries to repair your own copy of an old Android game so it installs and runs on modern Android. Works on the device, no root needed. For devices whose CPU can run 32-bit apps (32-bit or 32+64-bit CPU). For a 64-bit-only CPU use the companion project SoA32to64.

Tested games: Haegemonia: Legions of Iron, Imperium Galactica 2, Colin McRae Rally, Carmageddon, Dead Space, Mass Effect: Infiltrator (its data files go into Android/obb, not Android/data). Other games may or may not work.

This app contains no game files and does not download any.
